_about: The beach prototypes (proto-beach, 2 Nov 2026; build/reports/designs/beach-boat.md): the words and lines the beach games need that the family has not recorded yet. Every one is an English placeholder (kutchi: null), to record (Mum's beach sheets A and B, beach-boat.md §1); build/lang/import_modes.mjs turns each word into a to-record entry and each line into an engine meaning, so the games ask the language engine for them like any other line and it answers with the grey-italic English. Nothing here is Kutchi. Re-run node build/lang/import_all.mjs after a change.
